The problem

Searching for a trip still means hours across OTAs, Google and LLM chat, and the traveller does all the work.

Search gives travellers options. They want a trip that’s planned, booked and looked after.

  • Today’s trip starts with research across OTAs, Google and LLM chat, in a stack of tabs.
  • Search returns options, not a plan that fits the traveller and the people they’re travelling with.
  • After booking, the traveller is on their own: re-entering details, changing plans and sorting out problems.
  • The traveller is treated as a customer per transaction, not a traveller across the whole trip.

The product

Alfred is the agent for the whole trip: plan, book, travel, service.

Search stops at planning. Alfred carries on through booking, travel and servicing.

01Plan
Everything a traveller does to plan a trip

Flights, hotels, paid and free activities, restaurants, Trip Trust (visas, weather, safety), price comparison and a pre-trip checklist.

02Book
Book it all

Integrated with service providers, so the agent can book flights, hotels, activities, restaurants, eSIMs and travel insurance.

03Travel
Hey Alfred, it’s raining today. Can you reschedule my activities and restaurants?
A dynamic mobile app, not a static PDF

Hey Alfred is built in, for flexibility and change.

04Service
Hey Alfred travels with you

Flights get delayed. Destinations change entry requirements. Hey Alfred researches the options, you decide, and it acts for you.

Where search stops
Where Alfred carries on: booking, travel and servicing

Differentiation

What makes Alfred work as an agent: it carries the whole trip, and it knows the group.

ChannelAlfred app (B2C)
ChannelPartner platforms (B2B2C)
01Understand
02Build
03Adjust
04Learn
The traveller and their travelling party

Carries the whole trip

Books without travellers repeating their details, changes plans on the ground with Hey Alfred, and looks after the trip when things go wrong. Most AI planners stop at the plan.

Knows the travelling group

The same traveller wants different things with a partner, with the kids or with friends. Alfred asks the destination first, then who’s coming, and captures likes, dislikes and must-dos for the party.

Learns with every edit

Every change, in the app or on a partner platform, makes the next recommendation fit the traveller and the travelling party better.

Traveller, not customer

Alfred stays with the traveller across the whole trip and the next one.

Business model

One agent, two routes to the same traveller.

Direct · B2C

The Alfred app (web, iOS and Android) for families

Free and Pro subscription, plus partner commissions on bookings.

Travellers come to Alfred to plan, book and adjust the whole trip with Hey Alfred.

Embedded in OTAs and partners

The itinerary, built after purchase

Once a traveller buys with an OTA, Alfred turns those bookings into a full itinerary and trip checklist, with a wide range of upsells along the way: transfers, activities, dining, eSIMs and insurance.

The OTA owns the customer for the entire journey, not just the sale.

Same agent, same traveller: plan → book → travel → service. Two routes for ease of distribution and integration into bookings and servicing, not for different features.

Travellers, direct

Leisure travellers who plan and book online, families first

OTAs and partners, embedded

Go-to-market

Grow direct with families, and pilot the checklist with OTAs and partners.

Direct · Alfred app

  • Grow the family base that already plans with Alfred: more than 7,200 sign-ups so far.
  • Pro subscription adds a revenue line on top of booking commissions.
  • Every trip teaches the agent more about the traveller and their group, so the product gets better as it grows.

Embedded · OTAs and partners

  • Pilot the post-purchase itinerary and checklist with OTAs and partners.
  • OTAs and partners integrate upsell opportunities into a workflow that makes sense: activities, dining, eSIMs and insurance, each at the moment the traveller needs it.
  • Open doors to airline, hotel and corporate partners through investor and partner networks.
